literal_proposed_definition:
def MediumAtom.sharedFirstFactorSmallResidualHighConductorZero (d : MediumAtom) (Y R : ℝ) : ℂ :=
  ∑ p ∈ d.primitiveFirstFactorCarrier,
    ∑ u ∈ factorCarrier d.Q2 ×ˢ factorCarrier d.Q3,
      ∑ v ∈ factorCarrier d.Q2 ×ˢ factorCarrier d.Q3,
        if ((u.1 * u.2).gcd (v.1 * v.2) : ℝ) ≤ Y then
          (((d.V * CommonSmoothCutoff.cutoffMass : ℝ) : ℂ) /
            (((p * (u.1 * u.2).lcm (v.1 * v.2) : ℕ) : ℂ) *
              ((p * (u.1 * u.2).gcd (v.1 * v.2)).totient : ℂ))) *
            (d.gamma2 u.1 * d.gamma3 u.2) * star (d.gamma2 v.1 * d.gamma3 v.2) *
            (∑ chi ∈ ((Finset.univ : Finset
                (DirichletCharacter ℂ (p * (u.1 * u.2).gcd (v.1 * v.2)))).erase 1).filter
                  (fun chi => R < (chi.conductor : ℝ)),
              auxiliaryCharacterSum d.alphaCarrier d.alpha
                ((u.1 * u.2) / (u.1 * u.2).gcd (v.1 * v.2))
                (p * (u.1 * u.2).gcd (v.1 * v.2)) chi *
              star (auxiliaryCharacterSum d.alphaCarrier d.alpha
                ((v.1 * v.2) / (u.1 * u.2).gcd (v.1 * v.2))
                (p * (u.1 * u.2).gcd (v.1 * v.2)) chi))
        else 0
one_complete_proposed_public_type:
theorem actual_smallResidualHighConductorZero_bound
    {eta : ℝ} (heta : 0 < eta) (heta1 : eta < 1) :
    ∃ C : ℝ, 0 < C ∧
      ∀ (B : ℕ) (sigma kappa c0 : ℝ) (d : MediumAtom),
        MediumAdmissible B sigma kappa c0 d →
        ∀ Y R : ℝ, 1 ≤ Y → 1 ≤ R →
          ‖d.sharedFirstFactorSmallResidualHighConductorZero Y R‖ ≤
            C * d.V * (1 + Real.log (32 * d.U * d.Q1 * d.Q2 * d.Q3)) ^ (20 : ℕ) *
              (d.U ^ 2 / (d.Q1 * R ^ (1 - eta)) +
                d.Q1 ^ eta * Y ^ (1 + eta) * d.U)
constant_quantifiers: C depends only on fixed eta and the fixed local cutoffMass / accepted generic High constant. It is selected before B,sigma,kappa,c0,d,Y,R, all original gamma/alpha/interval/residue fields and physical labels. The finite raw estimate needs no SW assumption and no sigma sign assumption beyond the original MediumAdmissible; sigma positivity and smallness are used only for the later outside power payment.
exact_generic_High_candidate_public_type:
theorem auxiliary_highConductor_mean_le
    {eta : ℝ} (heta : 0 < eta) (heta1 : eta < 1) :
    ∃ C : ℝ, 0 < C ∧
      ∀ N Q R k : ℕ,
        0 < N → 0 < Q → 0 < R → 0 < k →
        ∀ b : ℕ → ℂ,
          (∀ n ∈ Finset.Icc 1 N, ‖b n‖ ≤ 1) →
          (∑ q ∈ Finset.Icc 1 Q,
            ((q : ℝ) / (q.totient : ℝ)) *
              ∑ χ ∈
                (Finset.univ : Finset (DirichletCharacter ℂ q)).filter
                  (fun χ ↦ R < χ.conductor),
                ‖∑ n ∈ Finset.Icc 1 N,
                  (if n.Coprime k then b n else 0) *
                    χ (n : ZMod q)‖ ^ 2) ≤
            C * (1 + Real.log (2 * (N : ℝ) * (Q : ℝ))) ^ (12 : ℕ) *
              ((Q : ℝ) * (N : ℝ) ^ 2 / (R : ℝ) ^ (1 - eta) +
                (Q : ℝ) ^ (2 + eta) * (N : ℝ))

exact_actual_alpha_star_bridge.N: N=Nat.floor (2*d.U), positive by U>=1. Actual alphaCarrier⊆Icc 1 N, preserving both original interval cutoffs.
exact_actual_alpha_star_bridge.b: b(n)=if n∈d.alphaCarrier then star(d.alpha n) else 0. This one sequence is fixed before all p,D,k,q,chi and is one-bounded on Icc 1 N by actual admissibility.
exact_actual_alpha_star_bridge.identity: S_actual(k,q,chi) = star( sum n∈Icc 1 N, (if n.Coprime k then b(n) else 0)*chi(n:ZMod q) ).
exact_actual_alpha_star_bridge.proof: Finite zero extension, star_sum, star_mul and star_star; hence equal norms. No interval or alpha coefficient depending on p/q is introduced, no character-inverse/conductor-invariance lemma is needed, and full q nonunit restrictions stay in chi.

exact_grouping.T: T=4*d.Q2*d.Q3>=4; actual tail products v are positive and <=T.
exact_grouping.G: G(v)=Σu∈(factorCarrier Q2×factorCarrier Q3).filter(u1*u2=v), gamma2(u1)*gamma3(u2). Group the complex coefficients before taking any norm, with G(v1)*star G(v2) exact.
exact_grouping.majorant: norm G(v) <= tau(v), by inclusion of the actual ordered factor-pair fiber in v.divisorsAntidiagonal, whose card is v.divisors.card; actual norm gamma2*gamma3<=1. G is never assumed one-bounded.
exact_grouping.D_k_l: Regroup exact original v1,v2 by D=gcd(v1,v2), v1=D*k,v2=D*l, gcd(k,l)=1. D>=1, D<=T and D<=Y; k,l lie in Icc 1 (floor T / D).
exact_grouping.physical_coefficient: With delta=p*D and lcm(v1,v2)=D*k*l, actual coefficient V*cutoffMass/[p*lcm*phi(delta)] equals V*cutoffMass/(p^2*D^2) * (delta/phi(delta)) *1/(k*l). All p may be composite and p,D may share factors.

weighted_Young_and_harmonic_moments.weights: For each fixed D, w_k=norm G(D*k)/k >=0, with w_k<=tau(D)*tau(k)/k.
weighted_Young_and_harmonic_moments.common_character_carrier: For fixed p,D, ambient chi modulo p*D and the high conductor filter depend on p,D,R only; they are common to every k,l.
weighted_Young_and_harmonic_moments.inequality: After taking norms and only then dropping gcd(k,l)=1, Σk,l w_k*w_l*abs(S_k)*abs(S_l) <= (Σk w_k)*(Σk w_k*norm(S_k)^2). This is weighted Young/Cauchy; prove 2ab<=a²+b² then finite symmetry, or use weighted finite Cauchy.
weighted_Young_and_harmonic_moments.first_fixed_D_moment: W_D=Σk w_k <= tau(D)*(1+log T)^2, using divisor submultiplicativity and native sum_fouvryTau_div_le_real at order2.
weighted_Young_and_harmonic_moments.remaining_k_moment: After applying the same generic High bound uniformly for every k, Σk w_k contributes another tau(D)*(1+log T)^2. Total exact tail cost tau(D)^2*(1+log T)^4. No tau(k)<=X^epsilon replacement.
weighted_Young_and_harmonic_moments.D_second_sum: Σ_{1<=D<=min(Y,T)} tau(D)^2*D^eta <= Y^(1+eta) * Σ_{1<=D<=T}tau(D)^2/D <= Y^(1+eta)*(1+log T)^4. Preserve the actual D<=T before extension, so no unbounded log Y cost appears.

p_to_level_mean_exact_scaling.parameters: P=floor(2*Q1), Q_D=P*D, N=floor(2*U). All positive for each original physical D>=1.
p_to_level_mean_exact_scaling.injection: For fixed D, p↦q=p*D is injective and maps the full actual primitive p carrier into Icc 1 Q_D. Both the original alpha b and auxiliary k are fixed inside this p sum.
p_to_level_mean_exact_scaling.second_inverse_p: For p in the original carrier, Q1<=p, so 1/p²<=1/Q1². Only after this nonnegative inequality and the injection extend to ALL q<=Q_D.
p_to_level_mean_exact_scaling.fixed_D_bound: Generic High yields <= C_eta * tau(D)^2 * H^16 * V * [ U²/(Q1*D*r^(1-eta)) + Q1^eta*D^eta*U ], where r=floor R and H=1+log(32*U*Q1*Q2*Q3). All floor2 constants are absorbed into C_eta.
p_to_level_mean_exact_scaling.log_argument: 2*N*Q_D <= 2*(2U)*(2Q1D) <= 8*U*Q1*T = 32*U*Q1*Q2*Q3. Also 1+log T<=H. Thus generic log^12 + the two k harmonic moments log^4 + D reciprocal square moment log^4 give exactly log^20.
p_to_level_mean_exact_scaling.after_D_sum: Raw norm <= C_eta * V * H^20 * [ U²/(Q1*r^(1-eta)) + Q1^eta*Y^(1+eta)*U ]. The first term retains the required 1/Q1.

real_R_to_natural_r.r: r=floor R, with R>=1 gives r>=1.
real_R_to_natural_r.filter_exactness: For R>=0, Nat.floor_lt gives floor R < conductor chi iff R < (conductor chi:real), so the real high cutoff transports exactly. The physical erase1 carrier is a subset of the generic all-character filtered carrier; extending its nonnegative square sum is legitimate.
real_R_to_natural_r.denominator: Nat.lt_floor_add_one R and r>=1 give R<r+1<=2r, hence r>=R/2. For 0<eta<1, 1/r^(1-eta)<=2^(1-eta)/R^(1-eta); absorb only this eta-dependent constant. Do not pretend r=R.

true_outside_payment.normalized_energy: Multiplying the proposed raw bound yields <= C_eta*X²*fixedLog^(eB+20) * [ R^(-(1-eta)) + (Q1*Y/U)*(Q1*Y)^eta ]. No extra Q1 is omitted.
true_outside_payment.choices: eta=sigma/16, Y=X^(sigma/4), R=(log X)^H0. Under 0<sigma<1/100, eta is positive and <1, Y>=1 and R>=1 for X sufficiently large.
true_outside_payment.power_calculation: Actual Q1<U*X^(-sigma) gives Q1*Y/U < X^(-3sigma/4). Actual U<=X gives Q1*Y<=X, hence (Q1*Y)^eta<=X^eta. Therefore the second relative term <=X^(-3sigma/4+sigma/16)=X^(-11sigma/16). No other stronger original geometric inequality is required; all existing original geometry remains in admissibility.
true_outside_payment.uniform_logs: U,Q1,Q2,Q3<=X under actual sigma-positive admissibility, so H<= (5+log32)*log X when log X>=1; likewise 1+log(2V)<=constant*log X. All exponent costs are fixed before i.
true_outside_payment.choose_R_cutoff: For desired signed-error log exponent A, select fixed H0 with H0*(1-eta)>2*A+eB+20 (plus any explicitly budgeted later fixed logs); this pays the first energy term. The X^(-11sigma/16) term pays every fixed log by the genuine power/log asymptotic. R_i and Y_i may vary with scale; all constants and scalar thresholds still precede i.
true_outside_payment.low_and_large_compatibility: Use the already specified Low all-D theorem at L=H0 and a sufficiently large arbitrary output log exponent; its original SW constants precede i. High large-D outside is X²[1/Y+Q1/U] times fixed logs, paid by X^(-sigma/4)+X^(-sigma).

exact_three_way_partition.identity: Σp[(q1SliceAtom p).transposedAtom.complexCRTSmoothZeroPart - primitiveZeroMain(q1SliceAtom p)] = LowZero(R) + SmallResidualHighZero(Y,R) + LargeResidualHighZero(Y,R).
exact_three_way_partition.finite_partition: At each original p,u,v, partition erase1 characters by conductor<=R versus R<conductor. In the high part partition the same actual D by D<=Y versus Y<D. Finite distributivity and sum_filter/complement identities prove this before all norms.
exact_three_way_partition.disjointness: Low covers ALL D, small-high uses D<=Y and high conductor, large-high uses Y<D and high conductor. No overlap, no omitted low-conductor large-D terms, no changed primitive center.
exact_three_way_partition.boundary: This closes only the raw-zero covariance conductor/physical-D decomposition after actual proof/verification. It does not by itself identify U/V primitive centers, bound all nonzero frequencies, establish RestrictedMediumTarget, or prove main Theorem1.1.
